Game Overview

At its heart, Cell Escape is a puzzle game about guide a prisoner to freedom through 60 intricate levels by destroying blocks and navigating physics-based puzzles. Each move tests your problem-solving prowess as you strategically clear paths to a grassy haven. Creativity, patience, and resetting when needed are essential to mastering this challenging escape adventure.
